goal: must make docs enrich resolve preset chapter order with the current project root so plugin registry presets in .senti/config.json type are available during senti docs build.

analysis.problem: Issue #402 reports that senti docs build --verbose emits [presets] resolveChain failed warnings for plugin registry presets such as coding-rule, document, and senti-plugin during the docs enrich step. The root cause is that runEnrich in src/docs/commands/enrich.js calls resolveChaptersOrder(type, undefined) without the project root, so resolveChainSafe only sees builtin presets and cannot load registry contributions for the current project.
analysis.proposedApproach: Pass the current docs context root into resolveChaptersOrder from docs enrich, matching the existing docs init and docs readme preset resolution path. Keep plugin registry loading, preset definitions, and chapter merge behavior unchanged.
analysis.validation: Source inspection confirms docs enrich destructures root from ctx but does not pass it to resolveChaptersOrder, while src/docs/commands/init.js and src/docs/commands/readme.js call resolveChaptersOrder(type, configChapters, root). resolveChaptersOrder forwards projectRoot to resolveChainSafe in src/docs/lib/template-merger.js, and resolveChainSafe uses src/lib/presets.js registry lookup only when a project root is provided. The fix addresses the root problem because the missing project root is the boundary between builtin-only resolution and project plugin registry resolution.
